title: Linear velocity expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly expressed as v = 2π(R+h)/T.

title: Density expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be correctly expressed as ρ = 3π(R+h)³/(GT²R³).

title: Centripetal force setup
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's second law, equating gravitational force to the required centripetal force for circular motion.

title: Period-velocity relationship
description: Important: The solution must correctly relate orbital period T to linear velocity v and orbital radius (R+h).

title: Mass elimination
description: Important: The solution must correctly eliminate the satellite mass m from the force equation.

title: Lunar volume substitution
description: Important: The solution must substitute the lunar mass M using the definition of density and the volume of a sphere.

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Optional: The solution shows clear, logical algebraic steps to derive the final density expression from the combined equations.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The solution includes or implies a check that the final density expression has correct units (mass/volume).

title: Incorrect radius usage
description: Pitfall: Using R instead of (R+h) for the orbital radius in the centripetal acceleration or gravitational force.

title: Sign or constant error
description: Pitfall: Misplacing factors of 2, π, or 3 in the final expressions, or omitting the gravitational constant G.
